certificate.source_clause: Execute a deterministic Transfer Matrix Method optimization for a planar stack with the following fixed topology: Incident Medium (Air, n=1.0) | Layer 1 (SiO2, n=1.46, lossless) | Layer 2 (TiO2, n=2.40, lossless) | Substrate (Glass, n=1.52, lossless). The stack must contain exactly these two finite layers. Optimize the thickness of Layer 1 and Layer 2, both constrained between 40 nm and 160 nm. Th
